Highly misleading fees. Groww's marketing implies 'zero brokerage,' but that’s false for active traders.
it’s free and it takes low brokerage
for f and o they say only ₹20 for buy and sell. total ₹40 for trade. but iam charged ₹69 and ₹79 per trade.

themes.description: Users are complaining about the high brokerage charges imposed by Groww, which is affecting their trading experience. The charges are perceived as high, especially for low-investment and short-term traders.
themes.business_impact: High brokerage charges may lead to a significant reduction in user profits, resulting in low engagement and potential churn.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The pricing model of Groww's high brokerage charges is not transparent, leading to user dissatisfaction and potential mistrust.
themes.action_plan:
• Revise the pricing model to provide clear and competitive brokerage charges
• Introduce a more affordable pricing plan for low-investment traders
• Provide detailed breakdown of charges to users before they initiate a trade.

themes.description: Users reported widespread failure of the app to initiate, login, load pages, place orders, and update data, causing frustration and loss of trust in the platform.
themes.business_impact: This theme impacts app adoption, user retention, and overall customer satisfaction, potentially leading to revenue decline and long-term reputation damage.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The frequent app crashes, login issues, and inability to load pages might be caused by poor quality control during the development and testing phases, highlighting a need for more rigorous testing and validation processes.
themes.action_plan:
• Rigorously test the app for functionality and stability across various devices and versions
• Update the app's architecture to address scalability and performance issues
• Implement automated testing and quality control measures
• Provide clear, timely communication to users regarding issues and resolution plans.

themes.description: Users are experiencing multiple critical errors while trading, including network issues, incorrect order execution, incomplete trade data, and misdisplayed portfolio values. Reviewers also report inconsistent behavior, such as feature removals and UI changes, which cause frustration and mistrust.
themes.business_impact: Potential loss of customers due to distrust and frustration with the product's ability to perform basic trading functions and display accurate data.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: Technical debt accumulated over multiple updates has led to integration and UI issues, causing critical errors and display inconsistencies.
themes.action_plan:
• Review and refactor critical trading code to correct integration issues
• Identify and restore removed features, ensuring data consistency and user experience
• Conduct thorough testing and user feedback gathering to prevent future regressions
• Implement clear communication channels for users and developers to address urgent issues
